title: CAT 2023 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Mixtures and Alligations
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: A mixture P is formed by removing a certain amount of coffee from a coffee jar and replacing the same amount with cocoa powder. The same amount is again removed from mixture P and replaced with same amount of cocoa powder to form a new mixture Q. If the ratio of coffee and cocoa in the mixture Q is 16:9, then the ratio of cocoa in mixture P to that in mixture Q is
questions.explain:
Let the jar's total capacity be $V$ and the amount replaced be $x$. 
After 2 replacements, the fraction of coffee remaining in mixture Q is $(1 - x/V)^2$. Since the ratio of coffee to cocoa in Q is 16:9, the fraction of coffee is $16/(16+9) = 16/25$. 
So, $(1 - x/V)^2 = 16/25 \implies 1 - x/V = 4/5 \implies x/V = 1/5$. 
In mixture P (after 1 replacement), the fraction of coffee is $4/5$, so cocoa is $1/5$ of $V$. 
In mixture Q (after 2 replacements), the fraction of cocoa is $9/25$ of $V$. 
The ratio of cocoa in P to cocoa in Q is $(1/5) : (9/25) = 5/25 : 9/25 = 5 : 9$.
